why: Controls the constructed-renderer pass finds under this project's own 28px coarse-pointer floor, on real production renderer output no fixture in scenarios.mjs ever mounted. Not an allowance: every one of these is a real shortfall, exactly like the fixture baseline it sits beside. The remaining classes here are recurrences the fixture baseline already tracks, now also visible on the real renderer at production row counts (a control the fixture pass measured once shows up here dozens or hundreds of times because a 1600-2000 row bench table/gallery/calendar/timeline actually repeats it). Resizing them is the same operator-scale decision the fixture baseline's own `why` describes, not a repair this pass makes silently.

raiseHistory.what: 367 -> 422, the second raise recorded here (the first, 335 -> 367 on the same date, added the timeline's four extra scale scenarios and is preserved in this file's git history rather than restated). touch-targets.mjs and unstyled-links.mjs stopped reading render-assertion-bundle.mjs's SCENARIOS directly and now read the new SCENARIOS_WITH_STATES export, which appends the ten per-view state variants T028 built (a subtask tree on board/timeline, sparse fields on list, a no-date-field empty state and the mini-calendar popover on calendar, the chart's number and empty-state variants, and the three toolbar settings popovers). Was 21 constructed scenarios for both lanes, now 31.
raiseHistory.verification: Attributed per new scenario by mounting only STATE_SCENARIOS (the ten new entries) in isolation and measuring each one's own undeclared rows, then confirmed additive against the full 31-scenario run: board-subtask-tree, list-sparse-fields, calendar-empty-state, chrome-chart-number and chrome-chart-empty each clear the floor entirely (0 under). timeline-subtask-tree re-mounts the timeline's own nav chrome and contributes the three timeline-class deltas above (+1/+6/+1) and nothing else. calendar-mini-calendar re-mounts a full month grid at the small capture-sized dataset (contributing +18 db-calendar-month-segment) plus its own three mini-popover button classes (2/1/1). The three toolbar-popover scenarios (calendar-toolbar-options, timeline-toolbar-options, chrome-chart-options-popover) each open only their own settings panel via togglePopover — not a full renderer — contributing one visually-hidden anchor-trigger button apiece (all under floor by design, 24x8) plus their panel's own toggle-switch and numeric-input controls (1/4, 3/4, 6/4). Sum of the ten scenarios' own under-floor counts is 0+8+0+22+0+0+0+6+8+11 = 55 = 422 - 367. Every pre-existing class not listed above (db-calendar-more-events 56, db-calendar-week-allday-date 16, db-calendar-week-allday-more 16, db-table-footer-trigger 32) held its exact prior count, confirmed by diffing this run's per-class breakdown against a `git stash`-isolated run of the pre-change code on the same tree. render-assertions.mjs is unaffected by construction: it still imports SCENARIOS (the original 21-entry export, unchanged), never SCENARIOS_WITH_STATES, so its BAGS lookup and coverage ratchet never see the three new toolbar `renderer` values. No styles.css or src/views change accompanies this raise. Note: touch-targets.mjs's printed/JSON `scenario` tag for the seven new entries that reuse an existing renderer/bag pair (board, timeline, list, calendar x2, chart x2) prints via the shared scenarioLabel() helper, which collides with the pre-existing plain scenario's own label (e.g. both read `calendar/file-view`) since scenarioLabel() keys only on renderer/bag/scale; this file's own perClass attribution above was computed directly against each ScenarioSpec instead, so it is unaffected. unstyled-links.mjs does not share this limitation — it tags constructed rows with `scenario.name`, which is unique per entry.

rebaseReconciliation.what: worktrees/025-row6-state-lanes was rebased onto main after main absorbed the one-to-one board port (854c748, 46a8525), which touched render-assertion-harness.ts and the tools/live/*.json evidence stamps but not this file or render-assertion-bundle.mjs. This file's own `raiseHistory` above (367 -> 422) auto-merged cleanly onto main, carrying no conflict, so re-measurement was to confirm the number still held rather than to resolve one.
rebaseReconciliation.verification: `node tools/live/touch-targets.mjs` on the rebased tree: constructed pass reports 422 under the 28px floor against a recorded baseline of 422 (fixture pass 264 against 279, unaffected), exit 0, PASS in both passes. The board port changed no styles.css class this file's perClass breakdown names and mounted no additional constructed scenario, so an unchanged count was the expected outcome, now confirmed rather than assumed. The total interactive-element count the constructed pass scans dropped 57060 -> 50462 (stable across two independent runs), and `node tools/live/unstyled-links.mjs`'s constructed link total dropped 144 -> 72 in step — both consistent with the board port rewriting the kanban structure one-to-one, neither a regression: the pass/fail-relevant numbers (422 under-floor, 0 UA-default link findings) are exactly unchanged.

lastTriage.what: db-row-insert-button, db-gallery-card-open and db-timeline-mobile-menu-button raised to the 28px floor by adding them to styles.css's existing `@media (pointer: coarse) { min-width: 28px; min-height: 28px; }` block (styles.css:21456-21469), the same idiom already used for db-list-row-open/db-source-rule-icon-button. No width, height, or position property changed on any of the three; the coarse-pointer minimum floats above the visual size only where a coarse pointer is present.
lastTriage.verification: None of the three classes are ever mounted by any scenarios.mjs fixture (grepped the fixture corpus for all three selectors: zero hits), so a full detached `npm run screenshots` recapture of all 276 entries could not and did not move a single pixel these controls draw — check-lane's content compare (pixelHash/layoutHash) reported 0 of 276 entries content-changed; the 9 that moved bytes were pre-existing encoder-noise re-encodes, confirmed unrelated and restored to their committed bytes rather than recommitted. `node tools/live/touch-targets.mjs`: fixture pass unchanged (264 under, same as its own baseline); constructed pass dropped from 8493 to 335 under the (now-lowered) baseline, exit 0.

note: The constructed pass first ran against no baseline at all (2026-09-03) and measured 8503 under-floor controls across 12 classes, red before any fix or declaration existed. Five of the twelve were newly discovered here — invisible to the fixture pass because no scenarios.mjs fixture mounts them: db-row-insert-button (22x22, 3998 instances — the table's hover-to-insert-row button, repeated at every row gap in the 2000-row bench table), db-gallery-card-open (24x24, 3200 instances — the gallery card's open button), db-timeline-mobile-menu-button (22x22, 960 instances — the timeline's phone-only overflow menu button, ironically missing the floor its own name promises), db-board-pagination-dot (12x12, 10 instances) and db-calendar-week-allday-more (67x13, 16 instances). db-board-pagination-dot is declared, not counted here: its `::before` inset is -16px on every side of a 12px dot, a 44px effective hit area a bounding box does not see (styles.css:19696-19699), the same shape as the checkbox exemption in touch-targets.mjs's DECLARED list, which now names it. The remaining four (8493 = 8503 - 10) were real, recorded here rather than fixed. A fix was drafted and verified for three of them the first time this pass ran, then reverted rather than landed because landing it would have invalidated the sourceHashes on eight unrelated census/audit artefacts (cascade-audit, checkbox-appearance, checkbox-inventory, design-conformance, engine-parity, surface-census, token-census, view-census); re-stamping surfaced that two of the eight — checkbox-appearance (a pre-existing 2.99:1 border-contrast shortfall on a board-drop-language fixture) and engine-parity (pre-existing Chrome/WebKit width differences, 520 vs 512, on unrelated fixtures) — fail for reasons that predate any touch-target work, confirmed by running both against the untouched tree: identical failing output. Those two remain a different scope's problem (WCAG contrast and cross-engine tolerance, not touch targets) and are recorded unchanged rather than fixed incidentally. This time the fix was landed: see `lastTriage` above for the applied change, the per-class before/after count, and the verification that produced them. db-calendar-week-allday-more (67x13, a real `<button>` inside the week/day all-day overflow row) was never a fix candidate for this pass regardless: raising its height sits inside the calendar's CSS-grid all-day row track (`grid-row` positioning shared with event-segment bars), an area this program's own history already flags as fragile (the runtime-vars.css calendar-formula finding), so it stays deferred pending a dedicated pass with its own capture verification. The other 7 recurring classes (db-calendar-month-segment 200, db-calendar-more-events 56, db-calendar-week-allday-date 16, db-table-footer-trigger 32, db-timeline-create-button 1, db-timeline-nav-button 12, db-timeline-scale-menu 2 — 319 total) are the same shortfalls the fixture baseline already tracks, now also counted at the scale a real renderer repeats them; 319 + db-calendar-week-allday-more's 16 = 335, the new baseline.
